title: Which box is the containing block for abspos descendants of a fieldset's rendered legend?
body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard? The fieldset rendering section doesn't say which box is the containing block for absolutely positioned descendants of a positioned fieldset. The anonymous fieldset content box inherits overflow but not position, so by the usual CSS rules the fieldset box would be the containing block for all of them. But all browsers make the anonymous fieldset content box the containing block for abspos content of the fieldset, so that it scrolls with the content (fieldset-containing-block.html tests this). The spec doesn't say that either. For abspos descendants of the rendered legend, browsers differ:
abspos
Chrome: the fieldset is the containing block. The span is at (10, 10) from the fieldset's border box, inside the border, and it doesn't move when the fieldset content scrolls. Firefox: the anonymous fieldset content box is the containing block. The span is at (10, 30), below the legend, and it scrolls with the fieldset content. This was reported in https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1535996. Safari: there is no anonymous content box. The fieldset itself scrolls and is the containing block for everything, with its top border expanded to fit the legend. The span is at (10, 30) and scrolls. Chrome's behavior seems the most sensible to me: the legend isn't inside the anonymous content box, so it seems odd for its descendants to be contained by it, or to scroll when the legend itself doesn't. css/css-break/fieldset-009.html already expects it, for percentage heights. In Firefox, the content box being the containing block also means the containing block isn't an ancestor of the abspos element's position in the box tree, which caused a crash (https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2094177). There's a patch to change Firefox to match Chrome in that bug. I've added a tentative test for Chrome's behavior, html/rendering/non-replaced-elements/the-fieldset-and-legend-elements/legend-abspos-containing-block.tentative.html. It will reach the wpt repo when the Firefox patch lands. What should the spec say the containing block is for abspos descendants of the rendered legend, and for abspos content of the fieldset?
